usage: 油漆 (paint) is a noun referring to the colored liquid applied to surfaces to protect or decorate them.
It can be used to describe both the substance itself and the act of painting when used with a verb.
You can say '塗油漆' (to apply paint) to describe the action of painting.
油漆 usually requires a brush or roller to apply it smoothly.
In sentences, 油漆 can be plural or mass noun, but usually treated as uncountable.
